why: Sensei gave up four hours in her cell to help her pass the retake, a real kindness, while no word was given or kept.
Morning and lunch banter plus an ice cream chat, with nothing given, kept or broken.
Routine reimbursement paperwork handled promptly, ordinary business with no promise that mattered.
Playful rooftop chat and a quiz remark, pleasant with nothing that mattered between them.
Sensei searched the arcade and lost-and-found and waited hours to return her charm, a kindness she had tried to dismiss, with no promise involved.
Sensei kept his promise to speak for her at the hearing and took the blame and the cost on himself.
Sensei kept her secret and then took the blame for the ledger error in front of Noa, a real risk to his standing, though the trust reading is close.
Sensei broke his word to have all three signatures by 11:00, though he then delivered them and apologised, so trust falls while regard is borderline.
Sensei gave a pinky promise to keep the cabinet crack from Yuuka, then told her about it, breaking that promise.
Practice session arranged and the room booked as agreed, routine planning with no word that mattered kept or broken.
Playful lunch and a light evening chat, pleasant with nothing that mattered.
Sensei signed her form, phoned the office and arrived when he said, routine help rather than a weighty kindness or promise, so regard is borderline.
Sensei broke his word to keep her snack-fund shortfall secret by telling Noa, though he apologised and offered to take the stocktake, so trust clearly falls and regard is borderline.
Sensei dismissed the cipher she made for him as kid stuff and turned it down, a slight, though no clear promise was broken.
Sensei promised to be at the arcade at 19:00 and arrived almost two hours late after double-booking, so trust falls while his tokens and honesty leave regard borderline.
Courtyard lunch, a music question and a late film, pleasant with nothing that mattered.
Sensei said he would bring lunch for the room, forgot Koyuki and waved her hurt off, so both values dip, with the promise reading borderline.
Sensei left Yuuka's treasurer credit off the public thank-you and brushed off her concern dismissively, a slight with no word broken.
Sensei kept his promise to sit in on the audit, turned down a free faculty dinner to do so, and found the missing receipt that balanced the ledger.
A Wi-Fi reset errand with Sensei waiting at the desk and giving directions, helpful but ordinary.
Sensei waved off her festival budget work, saying nobody reads it and to round the banners, which dismisses her effort, while no clear word was broken.
Budget review moved to a time that suited both, routine scheduling.
Friendly umbrella, bread and sock banter, pleasant only.
Sensei promised to come to the 16:00 robotics hearing and to speak for the club, then did not come and left the chair empty.
Toner request signed and delivered on time, a routine office errand.
Sensei promised every receipt by noon, did not deliver, and dismissed the gap as no big deal.
Sensei promised to join the co-op game at 20:00 sharp, went to dinner and forgot, so she played alone.
Sensei kept the booth for her so she could attend the mandatory hearing, ran the till correctly and fixed the price tape.
Cat, tea and cooking show banter, pleasant only.
Sensei kept his promise to attend the final in the second row, leaving a meeting early and risking a clash with Rin to get there.
Sensei spent seven hours at the head office collecting thirty-one duplicate invoices for her audit, a real kindness with no specific promise to her.
Sensei forgot the console and then recovered it, signing a loan in his own name and taking liability, so he kept his word after first breaking it, though his forgetting makes regard borderline.
